title: Miracle Crusade Momentum Building in Africa
description: Get ready to be inspired and equipped by Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful message about advancing God's kingdom and preaching the gospel to multitudes. In this sermon, Pastor Chris shares his vision for a massive tent crusade in Africa, where thousands are expected to come to Christ, and he encourages listeners to join him in praying for a great harvest of souls. Listen in to be challenged to live a life that honors God and to see the potential for miracles and deliverance in even the darkest of places.
